patch_description: The very low reversal count is accompanied by severe lag and poor correlation because a confirmed reversal is not actually committed to the tracker state. After confirmation, the existing 0.72/0.28 blend can retain the old slope sign, leaving the direction-constrained presentation layer locked in the previous trend for many samples. Commit the already persistence-validated proposed slope directly on a confirmed turn. This releases the monotonic output constraint promptly at genuine turning points, substantially reducing lag while retaining the existing two-observation and innovation-direction safeguards against false reversals.
